narr: An active summer pattern led to scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms, some of which produced damaging winds. In addition, heavy rain in a short period of time led to isolated instances of flash flooding in Lowndes county.
ev: Flooding occurred across several major intersections with N Ashley Street in downtown Valdosta due to 2-3 inches of rain falling in one hour.
